content.title: Tax Day 2026 is today. See food deals at Krispy Kreme, Subway, more
content.text: April 15, 2026, 10:37 a.m. ETToday is the big day!The deadline to file your taxes in 2026 is today, April 15. Wouldn't it be nice to celebrate the end of tax season with special treats that won't break the bank?Several restaurants and fast-food chains are helping their customers close out the 2026 tax season with mouthwatering deals.When is Tax Day 2026?The deadline to file your taxes is today, April 15.To file for an extension on federal income tax, taxpayers can fill out Form 4868 by April 15. Filing this form will give filers an additional 6 months to complete their tax return, until Tuesday, Oct. 15.Tax returns can still be filed after April 15 without filing for an extension, but you may be subject to a penalty if you owe taxes.Whether you're fueling up ahead of the big day or want to reap the benefits after submitting your return weeks ago, there are several deals to take advantage of across Florida:BJ’s Restaurant & BrewhouseAt BJ's on April 15, you can get $10 off your $40 order. You can also access this deal online with the code "TAXDAY."As of early 2026, there are 5 BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse locations in Michigan.Checkers, Rally'sFrom April 14 through April 15, Checkers will offer its Big Buford burger for $3. According to Franchise Wire, they will offer other value packs, including the Spicy Chicken Flatbread Combo for $5 and the Bacon Burger Flatbread Combo for $6.According to data site ScrapeHero, there are 58 Checkers & Rally's locations in Michigan as of late 2025.Church’s Texas ChickenMembers of Church’s Texas Chicken’s Real Rewards program can get an eight-piece leg and thigh order for $4.99 on April 15.As of March 2026, there are 10 Church’s Texas Chicken locations in Michigan.Del TacoDel Taco is offering multiple deals from April 15 through April 21, including a free Snack Taco with a $5 purchase, buy one, get one free Beer Battered Crispy Fish Tacos and $1 Grilled Chicken Tacos.As of April 2026, there are nine Del Taco locations operating in Michigan.GrubHubGrubhub is helping diners ease their “Taxiety” with the Grubhub Fee Return, which gives back $100,000 in Grubhub credit to diners who paid fees on food delivery apps in 2025.From April 6 through Tax Day (April 15), diners nationwide can visit GrubhubFeeReturn.com. Simply upload a 2025 receipt with delivery and/or service fees from any food delivery app for the chance to get $20 in Grubhub credit. Jersey Mike'sJersey Mike's is relaunching the Boardwalk Bundle for a limited time on April 13. The deal starts at $10.99 (an ode to the 1099 form). It includes a regular #2 sub, chips, and a drink. There are 85 Jersey Mike's in Michigan. Find a location near you here.Kona IceOn April 15, customers can visit participating Kona Ice trucks nationwide to receive a free kids-sized shaved ice in any flavor. Find a truck near you here.Krispy KremeOn April 15, customers can receive a free dozen glazed doughnuts when they purchase any dozen doughnuts at regular price in the shop or drive-thru, limited to two dozen per guest.Guests who order any dozen online at regular price for pickup or delivery can use the promo code “TAXBREAK” to receive an Original Glazed dozen for FREE! Limit one free dozen when ordering online via Krispy Kreme’s app or website.There are 4 Krispy Kreme shops in Michigan. Here's where.Marco's PizzaMarco’s Pizza is offering customers a large Pepperoni Magnifico Pizza for $12.99 with code "TAXRELIEF."According to ScrapeHero, there are 43 Marco's Pizza locations across Michigan. Find one near you here.Nothing Bundt CakesNothing Bundt Cakes rewards members can earn 50 bonus points on the purchase of any cake on April 15.As of April 2026, there are 14 Nothing Bundt Cakes locations in Michigan.Paris Baguette Rewards members can grab a free pastry with any beverage purchase on April 15.As of April 2026, there are 3 Paris Baguette locations in Michigan: Birmingham, Dearborn and Novi.Pizza HutPizza Hut customers can enjoy a large three-topping pizza starting at $10 with a choice of one of three crusts: Hand Tossed, Tavern Style or Thin ‘N Crispy. This promotion is valid in person and online on April 15. The Pizza Hut website lists more than 100 locations in Michigan.Portillo’sFrom April 13 through April 15, Portillo's Perks rewards members can score any slice of cake for just $1 with a purchase of $5 or more. There are two Portillo’s locations in Michigan, in Livonia and Sterling Heights.PotbellyPotbelly is offering customers a free original-size sandwich or wrap with the purchase of any big or original-size sandwich or wrap.This promotion is accessible on April 15 through the Potbelly app or website by using the promo code "BOGO" at checkout. There are 30 Potbelly locations in Michigan, according to its website.QDOBA Rewards members can take advantage of QBOBA's “Tax Day Guac Relief” on April 15. After completing a short survey on Tax Day, customers will receive $5 off an entrée, redeemable between April 20 and April 26.There are 73 QDOBA locations in Florida as of April 2026.Smoothie KingSmoothie King is offering $3 off to customers who join Healthy Rewards on April 15.As of late 2025, there are 19 Smoothie King locations in Florida. SubwaySubway is offering a BOGO deal on select footlong sandwiches through its app and online ordering platform through April 28. The offer is only available to Subway Sub Club rewards members.According to ScrapeHero, there are 773 Subway locations throughout Florida. Find a location near you here.WendysOn April 15, Wendy's is offering fans a free 6-piece Nuggets with a $5 purchase via the Wendy's app.There are nearly 211 Wendy's in Michigan, according to its website.Samantha Neely is a trending reporter for the USA TODAY NETWORK.
